headline: Approves a no-cost agreement with 3 O'Clock Rock for an after-school music program and summer camp
summary: 3 O'Clock Rock of Oakland offers an after-school music program and summer camp where kids write songs, play instruments, and record. It offers low-cost group classes, with scholarships from named nonprofit groups. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) this agreement, which runs March 1, 2022 through June 30, 2024 at no cost to the district.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Anya Diamond - Oakland High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Anya Diamond, Oakland, CA, for the latter to plan, organize, and train teachers to lead a backpacking trip in Point Reyes National Seashore over four days and three nights, studying the Seashore’s ecosystems and geographies and thereafter debrief lessons for teachers to implement to connect to what was learned outdoors to what is taught in the classroom, for Oakland High School, for the period of January 31, 2022 through April 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $7,000.00.
headline: Approves up to $7,000 to train Oakland High teachers to lead a Point Reyes backpacking trip
summary: An Oakland contractor plans, organizes, and trains Oakland High School teachers to lead a four-day, three-night backpacking trip in Point Reyes National Seashore studying its ecosystems. The contractor then leads a debrief so teachers can connect what was learned outdoors to classroom lessons. The board is ratifying (approving after the fact) this agreement, which runs January 31, 2022 through April 30, 2022 and cannot exceed $7,000.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Lend A Hand Foundation, Oakland, CA, for the latter to hold a 2-hour “Spring Fling” Community Event to support the wellness of OUSD McKinney-Vento students and their families by organizing resource tables staffed by members of the community for families in attendance; invite OUSD students and families currently living in cars, encampments and the two family shelters to attend the event; purchase two hundred (200) grocery gift cards in the amount of $50 each to be distributed along with a care package that includes books, essential supplies, and toys for each student in attendance; with activities designed to support the literacy, mental health and wellness of families living in cars and shelters, via the Community Schools and Student Services Department, for the term April 1, 2022 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.

summary: The Board approves, after the fact, an agreement with Envisioneers, Inc. to expand summer enrichment and support services at West Oakland Middle School, alongside the regular summer school program. Students can join in-person or virtual afternoon activities that make up a 9-hour daily summer learning program. The provider also does recruitment outreach and grant reporting, and the agreement runs June 6 to July 8, 2022.
